coach_says: You're fresh (TSB +2.4, HRV balanced, readiness 72), but Garmin flags excess anaerobic load, so this week the committed Tuesday double is your ONLY intensity — everything else stays aerobic to rebalance the load and consolidate fitness. Wet weather Monday–Thursday pushes those days indoors (gym, pool, yoga), with the long Zone 2 ride placed in Friday's dry window. Watch morning HRV on Wednesday and Thursday — if it drops sharply after the double day, swap Thursday's swim for full rest.

days.details: Lunch session (wet day, indoors anyway). Warm-up: 8 min — bike erg easy spin, glute bridges 2x10, band walks 2x10/side. Main (rest 90s between sets): Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (moderate load, ~7 RPE — no grinding), Single-Leg Glute Bridge 3x10/side, Chin-Ups or Lat Pulldown 3x8, Pallof Press 3x10/side, Side Plank 3x30s/side. Objective: posterior chain and hip stability without heavy quad-dominant loading — deliberately kept moderate because tomorrow is your key double day. Legs should feel worked, not trashed.

days.session: Committed double: AM hills + PM hard MTB group
days.details: AM (~60 min): Hills road ride — committed session. Weather is wet and windy, so either ride with rain kit on a familiar loop or substitute the trainer: 15 min Z2 warm-up, then 4x6 min hill simulation @ Zone 4 (upper threshold, seated climbing cadence 60-70 rpm) with 4 min Z1 spin recovery, 10 min cool-down. Keep efforts controlled at threshold, not anaerobic — your anaerobic load is already over target. | PM (~105 min): Hard MTB group ride — non-negotiable. Go race it, enjoy it, this is your quality for the week. Prioritise fuelling: eat before the PM ride and take carbs on board during. Refuel and sleep well tonight.

Mandatory easy day after the double. 45 min gentle flow: hip openers (pigeon, lizard), hamstring and quad stretches, thoracic rotations, 5 min diaphragmatic breathing to close. No loading, no elevated heart rate. Wet outside anyway — perfect indoor recovery day. If you feel wrecked, shorten to 25 min or take full rest.

Lunch swim, ~1100m total. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle + 4x50m drill (catch-up / single-arm alternating) with 15s rest. Main set: 6x100m freestyle @ steady aerobic effort (RPE 4-5, conversational if you could talk) with 20s rest. Cooldown: 100m easy backstroke/breaststroke mix. Objective: aerobic flush and upper-body recovery movement between Tuesday's double and Friday's long ride. Keep it genuinely easy — if HRV is down this morning, swim easy continuous 800m or skip entirely.

Total 3 hrs | Primary objective: aerobic base volume | Zone 2 throughout (RPE 3-4, conversational, roughly 65-75% max HR). Weather improves from Friday afternoon — flexible day, so ride when conditions are driest. Flat-to-rolling route, high cadence 85-95 rpm, stay disciplined on climbs (shift down, don't surge — no anaerobic spikes, that bucket is already full). Fuel: 60-80g carbs/hr from hour one, bottle every 20 min. This is the week's biggest aerobic deposit.

Dry day but Sunday is only an easy spin, so this is the slot to load the legs properly. Warm-up: 8 min — row/bike easy, bodyweight squats 2x10, hip airplanes 2x6/side. Main (rest 2 min on primary lifts, 90s otherwise): Back Squat 4x6 (progressive overload — add load from last block, ~8 RPE on final set), Barbell Hip Thrust 3x8, Single-Leg RDL 3x8/side (dumbbell), Standing Calf Raise 3x12, Dead Bug 3x10/side. Objective: main strength stimulus of the week — heavy bilateral plus single-leg control for pedalling stability. Optional 30 min easy walk in the good weather afterwards.

Total 2 hrs | Primary objective: aerobic recovery volume | Zone 1-2 only (RPE 2-3, fully conversational). Outdoors if the dry spell holds; if wet, cut to 75-90 min on the trainer with a podcast — no intervals either way. Legs will carry Saturday's gym load, so let them spin light at 90+ rpm and resist any urge to push. Closes the week at roughly 80/20 with Tuesday as the sole intensity block — exactly what the anaerobic surplus called for.
